originality.rationale: The assessed object is the 2023 Gaussian-modulated superoscillatory sum with a_n^2-1=c n; the assessed claim is its sharp fixed-c norm and spatial-profile three-regime asymptotic. A same-parameter 2023 coherent-state expansion and a 2024 finite squared-norm identity are recognized as prior; their stated conclusions do not determine the singular growing-parameter limit without additional saddle analysis. Relevant accessible primary sections and claim records were compared for actual implication rather than titles. Historical priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: A general theorem for norms of Gaussian-weighted superoscillatory polynomials with a degree-dependent complex target could imply the same asymptotics under another name.

Full text of the Karmakar–Jordan general approximation paper was not inspected; its accessible abstract is not sufficient for an exclusion claim.

value.rationale: For a canonical superoscillatory coherent-state sum, the maximum growth rate of nominal frequency compatible with bounded Gaussian Hilbert energy is a motivated structural question. A complete sharp trichotomy at a_n~sqrt(n) includes a critical quartic law and a split spatial-mass phase with an exact exponential prefactor, extending prior fixed-a analysis. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or unmotivated extra digit.
